terms.plainEnglish: The JSX attribute where React components usually put CSS class names.
terms.beginnerExplanation: className is where JSX puts styling class names.
terms.learningExplanation: className passes CSS class names to the rendered HTML element.
terms.advancedExplanation: className maps to the DOM class attribute in React's JSX model.
terms.confusion: In JSX, use className instead of the HTML attribute class.

terms.plainEnglish: A Tailwind utility that turns an element into a flexbox layout container.
terms.beginnerExplanation: flex helps arrange child elements in a row or column.
terms.learningExplanation: flex applies CSS display: flex so children can be aligned and spaced.
terms.advancedExplanation: flex establishes a flex formatting context for the element's children.
terms.confusion: Flex affects how the element's children are arranged, not the element's own text style.

terms.plainEnglish: A Tailwind utility that turns an element into a CSS grid layout container.
terms.beginnerExplanation: grid helps arrange child elements in rows and columns.
terms.learningExplanation: grid applies CSS display: grid, usually with column or gap utilities.
terms.advancedExplanation: grid establishes a CSS grid formatting context.
terms.confusion: Grid usually needs column or row utilities to describe the layout.

terms.plainEnglish: A Tailwind spacing utility that adds padding on all sides.
terms.beginnerExplanation: p-4 adds space inside the element on every side.
terms.learningExplanation: p-4 applies padding from Tailwind's spacing scale.
terms.advancedExplanation: p-4 maps to a generated padding utility from the configured spacing scale.
terms.confusion: The number is from Tailwind's spacing scale, not always direct pixels.

terms.plainEnglish: A Tailwind utility that makes text use a small font size.
terms.learningExplanation: text-sm applies Tailwind's small text size and line-height.
terms.advancedExplanation: text-sm maps to the configured font-size token for small text.
terms.confusion: Text utilities can control size, color, alignment, and more, so read the full class name.

terms.plainEnglish: A Tailwind utility that adds rounded corners.
terms.advancedExplanation: rounded maps to the default border-radius token.
terms.confusion: Rounded changes the border radius. It does not add a visible border by itself.

terms.plainEnglish: A Tailwind utility family that adds space between flex or grid children.
terms.beginnerExplanation: gap adds space between items inside a flex or grid container.
terms.learningExplanation: gap utilities set row and column gaps between layout children.
terms.advancedExplanation: gap maps to CSS gap values in flex and grid layout contexts.
terms.confusion: Gap affects space between children, not padding inside the container.
